steps.text:
The **NetworkDevice** model stores the physical inventory and runtime info for network devices.

**Primary key**
- `id` (string)

**Fields (all under `equipmentinfo`)**
- `equipmentinfo.vendor` (string) – device vendor
- `equipmentinfo.model` (string) – hardware model
- `equipmentinfo.series` (string) – product series
- `equipmentinfo.sysName` (string) – system name
- `equipmentinfo.ipAddress` (string) – management IP address
- `equipmentinfo.serialNumber` (string) – serial number
- `equipmentinfo.version` (string) – version
- `equipmentinfo.firmwareVersion` (string) – firmware version
- `equipmentinfo.location` (string) – physical location
- `equipmentinfo.deviceType` (string) – type of device e.g. switch, router
- `equipmentinfo.deviceStatus` (string) – operational status
- `equipmentinfo.uptime` (string) – uptime
- `equipmentinfo.lastSeen` (string) – last seen timestamp
- `equipmentinfo.interfaceCount` (int) – number of interfaces

You can query it with L8Query, e.g. `select * from NetworkDevice limit {{int:8:12}}`, and export with `export_csv`.
